integration_notes: Consumes the exact shared optional usage_metrics and daily_sessions contract. Browser does not calculate pricing or infer session presence from token totals. Missing old fields show unavailable, not fabricated zero.

Daily chart pages through at most 90 calendar days, initially showing the final page. Previous/next and a date input expose all dates; each page has a keyboard-expandable exact table. Zero-filled days come from applied response date_bounds via existing calendar helpers.
DailySessionsPanel owns chart destruction and AbortController listener cleanup. Main render unmounts it alongside existing chart cleanup; existing filter-state controller remains unchanged.

Negative cache differences retain their sign and explicitly say estimated surcharge. Partial estimates say priced subtotal and show exact cached-token coverage. Tooltips expose unrounded USD and percentage values.
Standalone report verification used the existing Python export_html implementation without editing Python. No backend service, live index, original logs or credentials were accessed.
